articles.title: NASA’s Chandra Finds Unusual Objects in Pinwheel Galaxy

articles.title: NASA Astronaut to Answer Questions from New Hampshire Students

articles.title: SaxaVord Scrapped Launch Rail Plans, Forcing HyImpulse to Bring Its Own
articles.summary:
UK-based launch facility SaxaVord Spaceport has confirmed that it abandoned plans to develop a shared suborbital launch rail, with German rocket builder HyImpulse now preparing to bring its own system to the Scottish launch site for the second flight of its SR75 rocket. articles.title: A call to boost European space exploration
articles.summary: The Call sets out a shared vision for strengthening Europe's role in human and robotic space exploration and provides political guidance for preparations ahead of the Intermediate Ministerial Meeting in Rome on 15 December.

articles.title: An Epic View of the Seasons
articles.summary: The tilt in Earth’s axis of rotation makes the apparent position of continents shift with the seasons in imagery from a NASA camera in deep space.
